voices.speaker: dhh
voices.theme: Default scope: keep the default install small
voices.quote: Appreciate the suggestion for this, but I think it's too much for the default installation.

voices.speaker: dhh
voices.theme: Taste of the maintainer decides defaults
voices.quote: I know there are a lot of yazi fans, but I don't really love it. I actually really like nautilus. File management is one area where I think drag'n'drop has its place. So going to skip on this for the default, but thanks for the suggestion!

voices.speaker: dhh
voices.theme: Say what is fixed and why
voices.quote: You're going to have to offer more information on a PR than that. Can't just dump a 400-line change without any context on what's being fixed or why.

voices.speaker: dhh
voices.theme: Too big: ship it as an optional package
voices.quote: Interesting path, but too big for Omarchy itself. Do explore an optional AUR package for this!

voices.speaker: dhh
voices.quote: I think this is a good addition to a user-specific config, but I don't want to open the door to the default starship config having a million env-specific configs, so going to skip this for the default. Thanks for the suggestion, though ✌️

voices.speaker: dhh
voices.theme: Complexity cost, even after the work was done
voices.quote: Living with this for a while, I think it's not frequent enough that this is needed to warrant the additional complexity to the menu. Very much appreciate the work, but it's easy for us to add too much, and I think this is just over that line.

voices.speaker: dhh
voices.quote: Appreciate the effort, but I don't want to take on the maintenance of keeping themes for multiple terminals in sync. But could make for a nice add-on project for those who want that!

voices.speaker: dhh
voices.quote: Ah, looks that then by design. The pinks just look a bit off to me. But let's just merge this for now and then continue tweaking in a follow up. Thanks for working on this!

voices.speaker: dhh
voices.quote: Thanks! Your V2 dedupe, `OPENCODE_DB`, Console session login, alternate payload shape, and per-key cache are folded into the OpenCode collector in #14040 (credited there). Closing in favor of that.

voices.speaker: dhh
voices.quote: Thanks for this! The agents panel was redesigned in #13770 into a single page with every agent and account at once, with a new scroll view and height fitting, which should take care of the few-pixel scroll. If it still happens on current quattro, please reopen with the steps.

voices.speaker: bjarneo
voices.theme: Duplicates: the earlier PR is kept
voices.quote: Automated duplication check: this pull request looks similar to #6924, which covers the same SUPER+J togglesplit guard for scrolling layouts. I keep that one open and close this one to consolidate review. If you feel this is the wrong decision, please open the PR again with a note on the difference.

voices.speaker: dhh
voices.quote: Update: this was pulled back out of #14049. Syncing usage between machines turned out to be more machinery than it's worth for Omarchy, so we're not taking it after all. Thanks for the work regardless.
